description: This file defines the LowOrderFee model class for OpenCart, which adds a low order fee to the shopping cart total if the subtotal is below a configured threshold.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: Model class for calculating and adding low order fee to the cart total in OpenCart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies a low order fee if the cart subtotal is below a configured threshold, updating the totals, taxes, and total amount.
